arbitrary_partition_realization.statement: For every partition Pi of a finite set X, the discrete category on X admits a prospectively fixed functor to a discrete category whose image-isomorphism kernel is exactly Pi.
arbitrary_partition_realization.construction: Use one target object for each block of Pi, map every source object to its block, and map each identity to the identity of that block. In a discrete target category two image objects are isomorphic exactly when their block labels are equal.
arbitrary_partition_realization.audit_consequence: Prospective fixation is a necessary provenance condition but is not a mathematical discriminator: by itself it excludes neither the identity relation nor the universal relation nor any intermediate finite partition. Independent source derivation or admissibility evidence for I is still required.

marked_interface_counterexample.domain: finite simple graphs with an ordered pair of distinct marked endpoints
marked_interface_counterexample.operation: E adds the simple edge between the two marked endpoints if absent and otherwise leaves the graph unchanged

left_output.reason: the marked endpoints are already adjacent

right_output.reason: the new endpoint edge closes one cycle

marked_interface_counterexample.why_not_IFQ2_refutation: No natural comparison isomorphism I(EG) congruent to a target-side operation on I(G) is supplied; the countermodel demonstrates failure of that missing premise rather than failure of the conditional theorem.
marked_interface_counterexample.scoped_obstruction: The object invariant forgets endpoint adjacency, so an interface-sensitive operation does not descend to the H-kernel quotient. Arbitrary composition or later-dynamics congruence cannot be inferred without interface-completeness or explicit comparison data.
